website_summary.name: Hand Gesture Visualization Hub
website_summary.description: The website features a sleek, modern interface designed for real-time hand gesture visualization, with interactive elements and clear status indicators.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a dark theme with a gradient background transitioning between shades of gray. It includes two main sections: a video feed area on the left and a processing result area on the right. The video feed area displays a placeholder icon indicating where the camera feed will appear, along with a "Ready" status badge. The processing result area shows a message stating "No hands detected" with instructions to position the hand in front of the camera. At the top-right corner, there are two buttons: "Start Processing" and an information icon. The overall layout is clean, with rounded edges and subtle shadows enhancing the visual appeal.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to visualize hand gestures through a live camera feed. Users can initiate the process by clicking the "Start Processing" button. Once started, the system detects hand movements and provides real-time feedback in the processing result area. If no hands are detected, it prompts the user to position their hand correctly. The website also includes a ready status indicator in the video feed area, signaling that the system is prepared to capture the feed.

functionality_testing.expected_results: The camera feed card displays the live feed, and the processing result card reflects the presence and movement of the hand if the camera access issue is resolved. 7. Next Steps : Attempt to click the "Processing..." button again to see if the camera access issue can be resolved.
